title: XSRF cookie name must be changed in both app.py and utils.ts (and static bundle needs rebuild)
answers: How do I rename the mitmweb XSRF cookie?
Where is the _xsrf cookie set and read?
Why does the compiled web UI still use the old cookie name?
body:
- Server: `mitmproxy/tools/web/app.py` Application settings: add `xsrf_cookie_name="_mitmproxy_xsrf"` next to `xsrf_cookies=True` / `xsrf_cookie_kwargs`. Tornado uses it for both setting and validating.
- Client: `web/src/js/utils.ts` `xsrf()` reads `getCookie("_mitmproxy_xsrf")` and sends it as `X-XSRFToken`.
- Unchanged: the hidden form field `_xsrf` (login.html `{% module xsrf_form_html() %}`) and header `X-XSRFToken` are Tornado-fixed names, not the cookie.
- `mitmproxy/tools/web/static/index-*.js` is a compiled bundle containing the old name; needs `npm run build` in `web/`, do not hand-edit.
- Existing tests (`test/mitmproxy/tools/web/test_app.py`) set `xsrf_cookies=False`, so the cookie name is untested.
- Add a CHANGELOG.md bullet under 'Unreleased'.
applies: Only for the XSRF cookie name; the form field and header names must stay as is.
invalidReason: The work described in the note has not been applied. The current code in web/src/js/utils.ts still reads getCookie("_xsrf") instead of getCookie("_mitmproxy_xsrf"). The note describes a required change that hasn't been implemented.
